source.note: OPF 0.35 step 8: 0.34 slides with a layout and cell keys. svg034 is the SHA-256 of toSvg(deck, { catalogs: [gallery] })[0] by the v0.34.2 engine (packages/render and @openpresentation/gallery built at the tag v0.34.2); rewritten says whether fix() removes the layout (the slide then draws exactly so) or leaves the slide (the layout shaped it in a way no key of the slide says). Recorded 2026-11-20 on Windows, Node 26.4.0. A later change that moves the drawing of a slide in cells moves these digests too; re-record them from v0.34.2 only if that change is also meant for 0.34 slides, otherwise keep the rewritten flags and compare against the cells composed beside the layout record (fix-cells.test.mjs in core).
